verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI evaluation and observability platform with an in-product AI Assistant, so acting as an MCP client is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence only documents Galileo's own MCP server, which exposes Galileo to IDEs such as Cursor and VS Code. That is the server role and cannot be credited here. Nothing in the pack shows users plugging external MCP servers into Galileo so it can call their tools.
